sharedEditsNeeded: tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts: nativeNegotiationOutcome always runs a linear chain, which a join operator cannot; a join-aware mode (graph/stream/actor/timed only) would let joins share it. This branch keeps its own join form in its differential file instead.
notes: Native maskedmerge declares no framesync options (AVFILTER_DEFINE_CLASS): shortest, eof_action, repeatlast and ts_sync_mode are unknown options natively (exit 8). They are refused here, so [FS-OPTS] 'accept shortest' does not apply; the join step's shortest is always false.
The 8-bit arithmetic is the pinned template (b*(255-m)+m*o+127)/255, not the (…+128)>>8 written in the spec; a +128 mutation fails 5 of 8 differential tests.
Every pad uses sync=1, EXT_STOP before and EXT_INFINITY after, the vf_stack semantics of the shared join engines.
The sandbox Node was 22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24, so Node 24.22.3 was installed from nodejs.org (sha256 verified) and used for everything.
Reference: an unpinned sandbox build (--allow-unpinned-reference). Its ffmpeg sha256 differs from the linux-x64 pin; the tests check only the commit and --disable-x86asm.
Setup durations: bootstrap 4m07s (npm 9.5s, submodule 6.6s, reference build and relinks the rest); baseline typecheck + lint + boundaries + registry test 1m21s, all green before the change.
